title: Withholding the Cancellation Penalty on a Vacation Package
content:
When a party gives up their places on a package sold under one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products, the penalty withheld on the cancelled package is worked out from the desk's own cancellation schedule, the money the party had put into the package and the traveller's record with the traveller club, and it is withheld from the party as a whole.

## What the withholding does

Withholding the penalty adds a single cancellation-penalty line to that package's ledger for the party as a whole, carrying the money withheld and the calendar date it posted, and raises the net money standing against the package by that amount so that it is no longer money the party can have back. The party's package statement then shows the forfeited sum itemised as a cancellation penalty.

## How the withholding is made

The desk tool `withhold_cancellation_penalty_6c06e997` is unlocked and then called by the agent. It is an agent's own tool and is not handed to the party.

## What it is given

**`bundle_package_id`** — the internal reference number of the cancelled vacation package the penalty is being withheld on, as carried on the package record returned by the vacation package lookup. It is an identifier, with no set of fixed candidates.

**`cancellation_penalty_usd`** — the money withheld from the party, given as a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, with no currency symbol, thousands separator or sign; it is always a positive money value, and it carries no set of fixed candidates.

## What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the new package ledger line reference, the package the penalty was withheld on and the amount in US dollars to two decimal places. That sentence, carrying a ledger line reference, is what indicates the penalty was withheld; no other value is returned.
